title: Delphi Authorization Store
description: `$DELPHI_HOME/operator/authorizations.json` (spec 092 TA-1): the operator's test authorizations. Written only by `delphi test authorize` and `delphi test revoke` (owner-only, 0600), under the operator scope's advisory lock; its blake3 hash is pinned in `operator/ratified.lock` under the key `authorizations.json`. A file whose hash does not match its pin, or that has no pin, is ignored and logged, whatever it says. In slice S1 no run reads a record: nothing here is consumed or approves anything.

argv.description: The canonical argument vector, matched exactly: no globs, shell strings, wrappers, chaining or substitution.

binary.description: Absolute canonical path of argv[0] and a hash of it, taken when the operator authorized.

files.description: Every script or file the command reads and executes, each hashed at authorization time.

env.description: The fixed, scrubbed environment: no PATH search, no LD_PRELOAD, no DYLD_*.

purpose.description: The operator's words, shown at every use.

home.description: The Delphi home this record is bound to.

machine.description: The machine this record is bound to.

run.description: Required: the run id the operator chose; a launch must pass the same id.

expires.description: At most 24 hours after creation; the first-slice default is 2 hours.

uses.description: The counter a later slice decrements against; slice S1 never changes it.

request_id.description: The staged request this record was made from, or null for one the operator wrote at the console.

revoked.description: When it was revoked. Irreversible: a revoked record is only ever replaced by a new one.
